delete.after: is_deleted=True, deleted_at=now, save(update_fields=['is_deleted','deleted_at']); avatar/cover FK cleared per entity type

patch.after: is_uploaded=True; attributes replaced when key present else kept; save(update_fields=['is_uploaded','attributes']); metadata task when storage empty

post.db: FileAsset.create(attributes={name,type,size:size_limit}, asset=asset_key, size=size_limit, user=request.user, created_by=request.user, entity_type); is_uploaded stays False; storage_metadata default {}
post.rule: name = data.name (may be None); type = data.type default 'image/jpeg'; size = int(data.size default FILE_SIZE_LIMIT); entity_type = data.entity_type default False; size_limit = min(size, FILE_SIZE_LIMIT); entity_type not in [USER_AVATAR, USER_COVER] -> 400; type not in 5-mime allowlist -> 400; asset_key = f'{uuid4hex}-{name}'; create; presigned POST; 200

bugs: name=None renders key '<hex>-None' (no required check; views/asset.py:117,150). Port as-is.
size garbage (non-numeric string, null) -> int() raises -> 500 'Something went wrong please try again later' via handle_exception else-branch, not a 400 (views/asset.py:119). Port as-is.
Invalid-type message claims 'Only JPEG and PNG files are allowed.' while webp/jpg/gif also pass (views/asset.py:141-147). Port verbatim.
No authZ beyond IsAuthenticated: any authenticated user mints uploads; cross-user isolation only via the (id, user_id) lookup on patch/delete (404 mapping).

invalid_entity.when: entity_type missing/False or not in [USER_AVATAR, USER_COVER]

body.error: Invalid file type. Only JPEG and PNG files are allowed.

invalid_type.when: type not in [image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/jpg, image/gif]

body.error: The requested resource does not exist.

not_found.when: patch/delete get(id, user_id) misses (handle_exception ObjectDoesNotExist mapping)

size_limit: min(requested size, settings.FILE_SIZE_LIMIT=5242880 default); stored in attributes.size AND size column
